questions.question: What is Spider-Man's real name?
questions.explanation: Peter Parker was bitten by a radioactive spider and became the Amazing Spider-Man! 🕷️

questions.question: What planet is Superman from?
questions.explanation: Superman (Kal-El) was sent from Krypton as a baby before it exploded! 🦸

questions.question: What is Batman's superpower?
options: No superpowers — just skills and gadgets
questions.answer: No superpowers — just skills and gadgets
questions.explanation: Batman has no superpowers — just intelligence, martial arts, and incredible gadgets! 🦇

questions.question: What colour is the Hulk?
questions.explanation: The Hulk is famous for being big and green! Bruce Banner turns into him when angry! 💚

questions.question: What is Iron Man's real name?
questions.explanation: Tony Stark is a genius billionaire who built a powered armour suit to become Iron Man! ⚙️

questions.question: Which superhero uses a magical hammer called Mjolnir?
questions.explanation: Thor is the Norse God of Thunder and only the worthy can lift Mjolnir! ⚡

questions.question: What does 'DC' stand for in DC Comics?
questions.explanation: DC started as Detective Comics in 1934 — featuring Batman as a detective-hero! 🦇
